meta.name: Ensure that Neptune DB cluster has automated backups enabled with adequate retention
meta.description: Ensure that Neptune DB cluster has automated backups enabled with adequate retention
meta.remediation: Set backup_retention_period to 7 or more on every aws_neptune_cluster.

evaluators.description: Every aws_neptune_cluster keeps backup_retention_period >= 7. The provider default is 1, so a cluster that omits the argument fails.
